name: The St. Regis Florence
insider_take: Housed in a 15th-century Florentine palazzo on the banks of the Arno River, The St. Regis Florence seamlessly blends Renaissance grandeur with modern luxury just steps from the Ponte Vecchio.
whats_special: This historic palazzo was once home to Florentine nobility and features original frescoed ceilings, marble fireplaces, and antique furnishings. The hotel's signature Winter Garden restaurant occupies a stunning glass-roofed courtyard, while many suites offer direct views of the iconic Ponte Vecchio and Oltrarno district.
pro_tip: Book a river-facing suite for unobstructed views of the Ponte Vecchio, especially magical at sunset when the bridge glows golden. The hotel's prime Lungarno location means you can walk to the Uffizi Gallery in under 5 minutes.
dont_miss: The hotel's exclusive access to private tours of the Vasari Corridor - the secret elevated passageway connecting the Uffizi to Palazzo Pitti. Also experience their signature "Royal Suite Ritual" featuring a private butler and personalized city itinerary curated by the concierge team.
pros: Prime location on Piazza Ognissanti with stunning Arno River views
Elegant Florentine palace architecture with luxury St. Regis amenities
Exceptional personalized butler service and concierge expertise
World-class spa and fine dining restaurant showcasing local cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects ultra-high-end positioning
Historic building constraints may limit modern amenities in some areas
